digest.component_or_area: event-metrics readers over the durable ticket event store
propositions: Add read-only derivation functions over the durable ticket event store (including compaction-retired events) computing agent-process metrics with clean event signatures.
Use a hybrid data-access model: metrics needing per-event or multi-occurrence data read raw event files, while metrics needing a single terminal value read compiled state from reduce_ticket.
attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions from raw open→in_progress STATUS edges; two distinct sessions yield 2 and a single session yields 1.
first_pass_rate uses absence of last_reopened_at as the terminal signal that a closed ticket was never reopened.
rework_within_days(n) counts closed→open→closed transitions within n days from raw STATUS timestamps; a 3-day gap counts in n=7 but a 10-day gap does not.
revert_recovery counts only tickets whose reverts target a STATUS or COMMITS event, excluding COMMENT/LINK reverts.
